chapter.heading: Psalm 87The Privileges of Citizenship in Zion.A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A Song.
chapter.v:
His foundation
is on the holy mountain.

The Lord
loves the gates of ZionMore than all the dwellings of Jacob (Israel).

Glorious things
are spoken of you,O city of God [Jerusalem]. Selah.

“I will
mention Rahab (Egypt) and Babylon among those who know Me—Behold, Philistia and Tyre with Ethiopia (Cush)—‘This one was born there.’ ”

But of
Zion it will be said, “This one and that one were born in her,”And the Most High Himself will establish her.

The Lord
will count, when He registers the peoples,“This one was born there.” Selah.

The singers
as well as the players of flutes will say,“All my springs and sources of joy are in you [Jerusalem, city of God].”
